correctness.rationale: The crown-graph degree n-1 reduces ordinary defensive alliances to x,y >= t when r=0 and x,y >= t+1 when r>0. Single-deletion analysis gives disjoint (t,t) and overlapping (s,s,r>=2) local minima. Proper-subset analysis retains overlapping r>=3 as global minima. Counting ordered pairs of index subsets proves both polynomials and local-only H_{n,2}. Vandermonde-style overlap counting and Stirling establish both parity closed totals and the asymptotics; independent adjacency enumeration verified n=3..10.

value.rationale: Both minimality notions are central in modern alliance-enumeration and algorithmic research. The complete two-degree labeled polynomial classification of a canonical regular bipartite family distinguishes the sole local-only overlap obstruction, yields the exact odd central-binomial-square count, and quantifies its rare exception at large order. These are nonroutine structural and coefficientwise conclusions not implied by prior scalar parameters.
